description: This PHP source file defines a class 'EmailsViewDetail' that extends 'ViewDetail' to customize the detail view of email records in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for pre-render setup and display logic, including changing the status of an email from 'unread' to 'read' and rendering the email detail view.

classes.name: EmailsViewDetail
classes.description: A custom view class to display email details, managing the email's read/unread status and rendering the detail view.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the detail view by initializing the EmailsDetailView object, populating it with request data, and setting up metadata for rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Render the email detail view and update email status from 'unread' to 'read' if applicable.
